observations: Photo 0 shows two PlayStation 4 controllers, one blue and one purple, placed on a black surface that resembles a game console.
The controllers have red analog sticks and red action buttons, with a custom design.
The blue controller has a screen in the center, possibly a display or a modification.
The purple controller has a standard layout with a touchpad and a central PlayStation logo.
The background is a wooden surface, and the bottom edge shows a green artificial grass texture.
There is a watermark 'EASY GAMES & GADGETS' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' on the image.
No PS4 console, no games, no FC26, no 'hacked' label, no visible model or serial number.
